composition_contract.errors: Finite original exceptions retain previous stores. Invalid address, callback, memory and history bounds are separate native policy tests.
composition_contract.inputs: Synthetic explicit initial pokes and turn/poke/store commands; native replay executes the submitted DSL rather than recipes or expectations.
composition_contract.memory: Every sparse byte including explicit zero, all attempted memory stores, model writes, calls, interleaved events and draw count. All steps retain full snapshots.
composition_contract.publication: Sibling temporary files flushed and fsynced, fixture replaced then manifest last; interrupted pairs detectable by hashes, not a two-file transaction.
composition_contract.references: Only immutable git-show source with SHA256 verification; no helper imports or native outputs.
composition_contract.rng: Object seed and unrelated world/frame/shared seed words retained as supplied backing. Turning invokes neither callbacks nor RNG.
composition_contract.scope: Pinned original Creature_turnToward and slow_factor only; standalone borrowed sparse Memory, no Session or presentation integration.

input_protocol.canonical: integer decimal, null _, strings sUTF8hex, bytes bHEX, lists [comma-separated]
input_protocol.statuses: ok or actual original ValueError/IndexError/OverflowError; top-level ok means completed observation
